_about: 2-Butanol (1) + Methanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.33 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-butanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-butanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Wang, H.-x.[Hong-xing], Bu, X.-w.[Xiang-wei], Yang, J.-b.[Jin-bei], Jiang, Y.-p.[Yi-ping], Li, L.[Ling], Isobaric (vapor + liquid) equilibrium data for the binary system methanol + 2-butyl alcohol and the quaternary system methyl acetate + methanol + 2-butyl alcohol + 2-butyl acetate at P = 101.33 kPa, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 74 (2014) 85-90
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3, 4. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0021. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.24 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
